title: Prefill: MXFP8 / BF16 GEMMs, router/latent, AttnRes, small ops
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 1-node DEP4 slice, profiled (runs/P-GEMM/step_p/c4-nv-prof, overlay p-gemm-c4-cd5a5401 = int 9d3cb2b + P-GEMM); baseline 83.89 (INFRA 17:48) and the int 5718ef2 reference 84.53 are the same scope; achievable = nvfp4_modelopt at the same slice
gap_analysis: MEASURED in-step (c4-nv-prof, per MoE layer): 83.41 ms vs target 79.97 (achievable 72.7). GEMM mainloops at 0.96-1.10x model. Remaining excess: shared SiTU+MXFP8 act_quant 151 us/layer = 3.47 ms (the model prices it fused; standalone it is FMA-issue bound on 3 precise tanhf per element, ~32 us per tanhf pass, 4x its HBM floor; exact BF16 lookup tables do not help, measured), attn_res_mxfp8 fused epilogue +22 us per call over native AttnRes (41 calls: 0.9 ms; net it still saves 0.7 ms vs native + FI quant), router GEMM N=896 76 vs 58 us (0.4 ms), latent RMSNorm 28 vs 17 us floor (0.25 ms), router top-k 29 vs 4 us floor (0.6 ms), latent_down/up 1.06-1.09x, DSA gate sigmoid-mul 128 us x6.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: shared SiTU+MXFP8 quant 151 us/layer in-step vs model ~0 (priced as fused): FMA-issue bound on 3 precise tanhf per element (~32 us per tanhf pass); BF16 tables do not beat it (bank-conflicted gathers). SOL = gate_up GEMM epilogue fusion (B3).
MEASURED: router top-k 43 us/layer vs 4 us floor (precise sigmoid over 896 logits per token); router GEMM 1.30x (N=896 wave quantization)
MEASURED: standalone MXFP8 quant of the AttnRes output (40 us FlashInfer) per KDA in_proj / shared gate_up call - removed by attn_res_mxfp8 (B1, step A/B running)
MEASURED: native AttnRes 1.31-1.37x its byte floor; fused variant adds 15-25 us (serial per-token epilogue, 1 CTA/SM): needs a 2-token-per-SM redesign (B2)
MEASURED: DSA w_uk bmm 1.52x (P-MLA fuses q-quant into it), KDA f_b_proj 1.54x (402 MB BF16 write), dense down 1.25x
rubin_features: 2-CTA M256 tiles (full-rate operand fetch), exclusive TMEM allocation
oversized shared memory for deeper A/B pipelines
epilogue fusion (MXFP8 quant in producer epilogues)
plan: LANDED-READY: wzhao/k31ws-p-gemm @ cd5a5401ed (merges int 9d3cb2b0c2): B1 attn_res_mxfp8 (AttnRes writes the KDA in_proj / shared gate_up MXFP8 input), mxfp8_act 4-vector producers, router top-k one warp per token, DSA gate sigmoid BF16 table. All bitwise-tested.

B3 (decisive, -3.5 ms -> ~79.9 ms = target): shared gate_up GEMM (M=16384, N=12288, K=7168, MXFP8) with the SiTU + BF16 round + MXFP8 quant epilogue writing the shared_down MXFP8 input directly: the CUDA-core SiTU work (~100 us) hides under the tensor-bound mainloop (~265 us) and the 403 MB BF16 round trip disappears. Needs a persistent 2-CTA M256xN256 block-scaled kernel at cuBLASLt speed (FlashInfer sm107 CuTe DSL Sm107BlockScaledPersistentDenseGemmKernel is 1.14x cuBLAS by default: sweep its tactics first) with gate/up interleaved weight rows (permute the gate_up weight at load so each 256-wide N tile holds 128 gate + the matching 128 up columns) and an epilogue doing exactly situ_activation + c10 BF16 rounding + FlashInfer MXFP8 quant (bitwise test vs mxfp8_act mode 1).
B2: attn_res_mxfp8 epilogue overhead (+22 us/call, 0.9 ms): 2 tokens per SM / split the per-token quant epilogue across warps.
Small: router GEMM N=896 tactic (0.4 ms), latent RMSNorm to byte floor (0.25), router top-k further (0.6), gate sigmoid-mul in-step shape check.
